_comment: RQ3 for Jessica at 0.3 m, SWAP run: the same sensor pair with the two units exchanged, unit 1 in position A and unit 3 in position B (the earlier sweeps had unit 3 in A and unit 1 in B). Everything else is as in rq3_jessica_0p3_pair13.json: same angles, zones, repeats, run length and seed, plus 1 degree per side (a 2 degree angle between the sensors), which was not measured before. expected_range_mm is the pair mean and does not change with the swap, but re-check it with tools/live_ranges.py at the setup. square_offset_mm is B minus A on the squared board; the swap may flip its sign (about +2.5 before, so about -2.5 if it belongs to the units, still +2.5 if it belongs to the position), so it starts at 0, which is inside square_tol_mm of either. Measure it with tools/live_ranges.py on the squared board at 0 degrees and write it down: it is the first evidence of whether the offset follows the unit or the position. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/swap/rq3_jessica_0p3_pair13_swap.json --out data/swap
name: rq3-jessica-0p3-pair13-swap
notes: SWAP: unit 1 in position A and unit 3 in position B (the first sweeps had unit 3 in A and unit 1 in B). Angle 1 degree per side added.
